Its proposed Cu→climb→twinning link remains weakly supported and potentially questionable, but B is less physically grounded: it extrapolates substrate twinning observed at 300 K to coating twinning at 400–600 °C and asserts, without evidence, that lowering Cu increases both lattice friction and climb-induced twinning while largely neglecting oxidation.
